text_to_image_prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic female character portrait. Very long voluminous chestnut curls swept to one side, fair neutral skin, light hazel eyes, arched brown brows, oval face, soft pink lips. Navy school blazer, gray V-neck sweater with striped trim, white shirt and burgundy striped tie. Frontal upper-body pose with direct gaze. Single person on a seamless pure white background, vertical composition with the entire head visible and breathing space above the hair. Bright soft frontal studio daylight, low-contrast natural shadows, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, restrained makeup, subtle halation, realistic 50mm perspective, coherent cream-white and warm-brown color grading. Upper-body portrait; retain visible clothing texture and natural folds. No text, watermark, logo, collage, border, other people, scenery, plastic skin, illustration or CGI rendering.
